# RAS Solutions

RAS Solutions, also known to customers as RAS Laptops, sells open box, ex-corporate
business laptops online in Lebanon.

## Pages

- https://raslaptops.com/ — current stock: model, specification and price for every unit available.
- https://raslaptops.com/about — company details, warranty, delivery, payment, inspection, FAQ.
- https://raslaptops.com/estimate — free laptop price estimator for Lebanon: pick processor, generation, RAM, storage, graphics, screen, battery and condition, get an estimated value range in USD.
- https://raslaptops.com/choose — guided chooser: five plain-language questions about intended use, budget, portability, time away from mains power, and touchscreen preference; returns matching laptops from current stock.

## What is sold

- Ex-corporate business laptops: Dell Latitude, HP ProBook, Lenovo ThinkPad.
- 2-in-1 and touchscreen units that fold into a tablet.
- Desktops and mini PCs, monitors, docks and chargers, and accessories, when in stock.
- Categories shown on the site: Laptops, 2-in-1 & Touch, Desktops & Mini PCs, Monitors, Docks & Chargers, Accessories.

## Tools

- Guided laptop chooser: recommends from live stock based on what the laptop is for, requiring no technical knowledge from the visitor.
- Laptop price estimator: estimates what a laptop is worth in Lebanon from its specification.
- Output is a USD range, described on the page as a guide and not a purchase offer.
- Inputs: brand grade, processor family, processor generation, RAM, storage, graphics, screen, battery condition, physical condition, and extras such as touchscreen or backlit keyboard.

## Condition

- Open box, ex-corporate: machines retired from company fleets.
- Not new. Not consumer returns.
- Every unit is tested and cleaned before shipping.
- Cosmetic condition varies between units. A video of a specific unit is sent on request.

## Price

- Range: USD 220 to USD 430.
- Currency: USD.
- Every price is published on the site.

## Warranty

- 3 months on every unit, from the date of delivery.

## Delivery

- Free, anywhere in Lebanon.
- Timing is agreed on WhatsApp after the order. No fixed delivery date is quoted in advance.

## Payment

- Cash on delivery, Whish, or OMT.
- Card details are not taken over chat.

## Inspection

- The customer inspects the laptop with the delivery driver before paying.

## Keyboards

- Most units have Arabic and English keyboards.

## Sales channel

- Online only. No physical shop.
- Orders and questions go through WhatsApp.

## Languages

- Site content is available in English and Arabic.
